title: Widths of embeddings of Gaussian Sobolev spaces
summary: In this paper, we investigate the approximation problem for functions in Gaussian Sobolev spaces $W^s_p(\mathbb{R}^d, γ)$ of smoothness $s > 0$, where the approximation error is measured in the Gaussian Lebesgue space $L_q(\mathbb{R}^d, γ)$. Such function spaces naturally arise in the analysis of high-dimensional problems with Gaussian measures and play an important role in various applications, including uncertainty quantification and stochastic modeling.
